layout_sources: https://github.com/bank2ynab/bank2ynab/blob/develop/bank2ynab/data/bank2ynab.conf [SE Nordea - netbank.nordea.se] (header Bokföringsdag;Belopp;Avsändare;Mottagare;Namn;Rubrik;Saldo;Valuta, semicolon, file name "<account> - YYYY.MM.DD HH.MM")

Real exports kept in public repos: https://github.com/robinandreeklund-collab/Hembudget/tree/HEAD/data/Nordea ("PERSONKONTO 1722 20 34439 - 2026-04-21 12.46.46.csv"), https://github.com/albinrydberg/ynab-converter/blob/HEAD/testfiles/nordea-input-2024.csv, https://github.com/robinandreeklund-collab/Insights ("PERSONKONTO ... - 2025-10-21 15.38.56.csv"): UTF-8 with BOM, LF, a trailing ; on every line, YYYY/MM/DD, comma decimal with no thousands mark, newest first, Saldo after each line

https://github.com/kjelloh/cratchit/blob/HEAD/src/test/data/account_statements_csv.hpp (a newer 10-column variant, Bokföringsdag;Belopp;Avsändare;Mottagare;Namn;Ytterligare detaljer;Meddelande;Egna anteckningar;Saldo;Valuta;, seen from late 2025)
notes: Nordea Netbank (Sweden) "Exportera" as CSV. Semicolon-separated, no quoting, every line (header too) ends with a ;, UTF-8 with a BOM, LF line ends. Dates YYYY/MM/DD; Belopp signed with a comma decimal and no thousands mark; Saldo is the balance after each line; Valuta SEK. Newest first. Avsändare is your own account on money out, Mottagare on money in; Namn is often empty and Rubrik carries the text. Pending card lines would come first with "Reserverat" in the date column and no Saldo; this October export has none. Closing = the newest line's Saldo; opening = the oldest line's Saldo minus its amount. Since late 2025 some exports add Ytterligare detaljer/Meddelande/Egna anteckningar columns (the user can choose columns); the 8-column form is the one most often seen.
